translation.text: And he swore by his great name that from now on he would not do this to all those who live on dry land. And he caused a sign to circle in heaven: “Let there be faithfulness between me and them forever, for the duration of the days of heaven upon earth; and this is by my command.”[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Ethiopic uses a verb of causing to go round for the sign in heaven; it does not name the kind of sign. “Faithfulness” renders ሃይማኖት, whose primary lexical range includes trust and the good faith of a relationship; a pledge is another contextual way of expressing that relation, but the selected word is not the technical noun for a covenant. The duration clause retains መጠነ, “measure/extent,” with the days of heaven upon earth, without adding a new conjunction. The text shifts from third-person narration to first-person “me” and “my”; quotation marks are editorial presentation. The selected starred form ማእከሌሆሙ is retained without silently normalizing its letters. The broad critical bracket begun at 54:7 closes after this unit. Six spaced printed dots follow that bracket before 55:3; these are editorial source signs, not authorization to invent missing wording or to add a new opening bracket at 55:1.

all29_word_audit.observation: Native perfect mahal[a], 3ms; he swore agrees. Initial own reading retained.
Native final ሙ is u/possessed name, not my earlier መ; by his great name agrees.
Native abiy adjective modifies name; great agrees.
Complement kema introduces prospective oath clause; that agrees.
Native em-yiezze, not my earlier em-dehre guess. Latin1072-1073 now/hereafter-from-now; from now on agrees.
Negative i-ye-gaber, 3ms imperfect, no plural actor suffix; he would not do agrees.
kemez demonstrative manner thus/this; this is contextual natural equivalence.
Native kwelo-mu u/labialized k and lo, plural possessive mu, not my tentative kwelu-mu; all those agrees.
Plural relative ella; who agrees.
ye-naber-u third plural general inhabitants, not finite new singular actor; who live agrees.
diba locative on; agrees.
yebes dry/solid land noun; agrees.
Native we-te-emr-ta has object accusative ta. My early construct-noun segmentation was mistaken; sign object of next finite verb agrees.

Native a-wa-da has separate wa not wu, and da not final noun d. Latin999 causative II1 circumvertere/circumagere supports he caused to circle. My earlier awd nominal reading is rejected on native/Latin grounds.

CONFIRMED MISMATCH: main printed source is በሰማያት with terminal ት, plural heavens. Candidate has በሰማይ. Actual printed apparatus26 says e h o p(vw), b read በሰማይ, demonstrating candidate selects an apparatus variant rather than transcribes main print. This is not a damaged/unknown-fidel placeholder. Restore main word and preferably English in the heavens.
Native ye-kun third masculine singular subjunctive/jussive. Let there be is correct; not morphologically first-person. See source.note phrasing defect below.
Native maekele-ya five-part spelling with final ya beyond le, not my incomplete maekele. Idiomatic between me agrees; do not normalize the apparent doubled first-person formation.

Native selected starred maekele-homu retains le and ho in this edited spelling; candidate exact odd form retained. Third plural between them agrees. My earlier humu spelling in provisional freeze was a failed unaided read, corrected from native glyph/Table I.
Native haymanot, not oath. Complete Latin14 supports relational fidelity/trust/faithfulness. English faithfulness agrees and note rightly avoids technical covenant noun claim.
eske temporal until/up to; forever absorbs force idiomatically; no negation moved here.
lealam adverbial eternal duration, not world object; forever agrees.
matana extent/measure; source has no duration finite verb. Temporal for duration is acceptable here and note preserves literal measure/extent.
mawaela plural construct days of; agrees.
samay singular sky/heaven; heaven in days of heaven agrees, distinct from word15 plural.
diba locative upon/over; upon agrees, no new temporal conjunction.
medr earth; agrees.
Star after conjunct before demonstrative z retained, and this agrees.
b + teezaz + ya first singular possession; by my command agrees, not a new first-person finite command verb.
Native weetu initial w is sixth-order with copular value, not my earlier first-order we spelling. It is rendered is in this is by my command. Closing double stop and inherited ] retained.

whole_english_review.decision: HOLD due exact source word15 mismatch; remaining whole reading acceptable with reviewed explanation
observations: He swore is narration third singular, the oath contains future negative he would not do. No omission of negative, no plural substitution.
The sign is accusative and the separate a-wa-da form is a causative finite verb, not a genitive circle noun. Caused a sign to circle is supported, not an imported named sign.

Let there be is third singular jussive; relational between me/them and command my yield first-person speech presentation. Quotes editorially make this readable without converting he swore into I swear.
Faithfulness relational lexical sense, unnamed circling sign, and awkward extent/duration of heaven days upon earth are all retained, not harmonized to remembered English Scripture.

English in heaven can be natural number-neutral equivalence, but since the exact source mistakenly imported the singular variant, new corrected source should use main በሰማያት and in the heavens to make intended main-text choice explicit.

primary_latin_and_grammar_observations.observation: Actual cols155-156: mahala I1 jurare, jusjurandum dare; swearing with b is licensed. Noun oath entry at col156 means juratio/juramentum/jusjurandum. This noun is NOT what the native image has at words17-18; those proved maekel. Page157 starts the next mercy root, confirming boundary.

Actual col14 complete haymanot entry through boundary before its derivatives: fides qua creditur; also fides qua credimur/fidelitas (friendship example), then specifically fides vera crectu, and creed/confession use. Contextual fidelity is lexically supported; theological belief is not compulsory. Derivative continuation top15 does not turn word19 into oath.

Actual col784 complete maekel entry continues into785: medium/media pars/medius locus; accusative maekela is prepositional in media re/in mediam rem, inter, repeated between X and between Y. Pronoun suffix syntax supplies me and them. Adjacent derived nouns in785 are distinct entries, not the source noun.

Actual cols221-223 full matana entry and nominal uses: measure/estimate; substantive mensura/modus/ratio; construct matana marks quantum/tantum and temporal quoad, quamdiu, dum, tamdiu. This is as long as, not a separate verb remain/continue and not measure in physical units.

Actual col1000 complete awd entry with continuation1001: circuitus, ambitus, circulus; linea circumcurrens, orbis, periodus anni, circus solaris, locus circumseptus, area, threshing-floor and forum contexts. Here lexical circle/circuit with heavens chooses spatial circle, not a claimed explicit rainbow-color word.
Actual cols340-341 full sem/name entry and next semay entry: nomen, fama, memoria and authority uses; semay coelum with plural samayat. Name and heavens distinct and both constructs supported.

Actual col730 taamara verb passage is lumin praebere, apparere, prodigium; col731/732 related nouns include signum/indicium, insigne, omen and demonstratio/significatio/indicium/ostentum. Source construct sign/token need not be rendered miracle. Entry boundaries inspected across 730-732.

Actual col951 alam entire entry into952: aevum/saeculum/tempus antiquum and future perpetual time/aeternitas. lealam marks in aeternum/perpetuum; mundus/terrarum senses are separate, and not selected for this adverbial duration.

Actual command root azaza starts792; complete command noun teezaz in793-794 means praeceptum, mandatum, officium, statutum, jussus. First singular suffix in source yields my command; no necessity to invent because I command a second finite verb.
Actual1071-1072: yebes siccus/aridus and noun terra arida, sicca/continens as opposed to water. Whole entry read, not only the quoted gloss.
Actual1103-1105 diba entry: super/supra/in, over/upon; multiple temporal/causal/oppositional uses inspected. Here locative above/on earth; source has no independent duration verb.
Actual cols815-816 universal pronoun continuation and prepositional uses support all of them; no second set of inhabitants introduced.
Actual aby root and abiy adjective entry: magnus and time/coetus uses; here it modifies name. Whole adjective and continuation inspected.

Actual gabara I1 and II1, III1 entries through1162: facere/agere, creation/work/performance, perfecting/completing and passive/reflexive senses distinguished. Source igaber is third singular negative doing, not a passive of the inhabitants.

Actual nabara entry starts650, complete I1 continues651: sedere, stay/remain/esse, vivere/morari/habitare. Then causative II1 begins651-652. Source third plural yenaberu active inhabit/dwell, not causative place them.
Actual eske entry cols750-751: dum/usque dum/donec/quoad and preposition usque/ad. Combined forever phrase marks continuation to eternity, no negation transferred here.
